condition: When date-fns is bundled with Parcel (before 2.14.2), format throws "formatters is undefined" in dev mode, or the production build fails with "does not export 'format'", because of a Parcel tree-shaking bug.
workaround: Upgrade Parcel to v2.14.2 or later, clear .parcel-cache, or downgrade date-fns to 3.1.0.
